title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 23 | The Spirit Meadow | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
Glowing paw prints lead the party to a spirit fox... and to Kiri the Summoner. Kiri joins with her spirit friends, they calm the Storm Wisp, and spend the night under dancing spirit lights.

0:00 Glowing Paw Prints
0:45 Kiri the Summoner
1:30 The Storm Wisp
2:15 Spirit Lights

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
